data.one_liner: Lightweight library providing GeoJSON data types for Dart and Flutter
data.what_it_does: It defines classes for all GeoJSON geometry and feature types and offers parsing from JSON. The library is fully RFC 7946 compliant and supports Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection, FeatureCollection, and Feature.
use_when: You need to model GeoJSON data in a Dart/Flutter project
You want a small dependency that covers all standard GeoJSON geometry types
You require RFC 7946 compliance without extra tooling
avoid_when: You need advanced geospatial analysis or spatial queries
You require support for nested GeometryCollections
You need separate serialization logic or extensive documentation
strengths: Supports all standard geometry and feature types
